    result = df_group.copy()

    # Apply suppression to value columns
    if value_col in result.columns:
        result[value_col] = np.where(suppression_mask, np.nan, result[value_col])
    
    # Apply suppression to count
    result[count_col] = np.where(
        suppression_mask, 
        '<5 (suppressed)', 
        result[count_col].astype(str)
    )

    if 'mean' in result.columns:
